title: vicia tetrasperma var. laxiflora
intro: Vicia tetrasperma var. laxiflora, commonly known as  the four-leaf vetch, is a plant species in the legume family. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include the ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Vicia tetrasperma var. laxiflora include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
